text.p: Aureal Semiconductor Inc said Tuesday it expects a growing need for working capital to provide for the production of inventory and the financing of customer receivables.

Although funding for this growth is expected to be provided primarily from the company's working capital line of credit, the company said it is currently considering various financing options, including additional equity capitalization.

Aureal lost $3.5 million in the first quarter ended March 31, reflecting the company's continuing efforts in development of its advanced audio products, as well as continuing sales and marketing activities associated with the release of the company's new products.
